title: Happy giraffe
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- giraffe body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <!-- spots on body -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='62' r='4' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='58' r='4.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='70' r='4' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='76' r='3.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='72' r='3' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='80' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e0a92e'/>
  <rect x='46' y='80' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e0a92e'/>
  <rect x='56' y='80' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e0a92e'/>
  <rect x='64' y='80' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e0a92e'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='34' y='91' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <rect x='46' y='91' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <rect x='56' y='91' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <rect x='64' y='91' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='60' y='22' width='11' height='50' rx='5' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='65' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='58' r='3' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='18' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='10' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#e0a92e'/>
  <ellipse cx='77' cy='10' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#e0a92e'/>
  <!-- ossicones (horns) -->
  <rect x='61' y='5' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#e0a92e'/>
  <rect x='69' y='5' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#e0a92e'/>
  <circle cx='62.5' cy='5' r='2.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='70.5' cy='5' r='2.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='22' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#f0b840'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='21' r='1.2' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='23' r='1.2' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <!-- happy eyes -->
  <path d='M62 15 q2 -3 4 0' stroke='#3b2410' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M69 15 q2 -3 4 0' stroke='#3b2410' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M73 26 q3 3 6 0' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M24 65 q-6 -2 -6 -10' stroke='#e0a92e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='54' r='3' fill='#b5651d'/>
</svg>
